kind_defs.Ancestor: The founding strain of a treatment (t0). GOB21 founded the PA lines; GOB8 founded the PM and PO lines.
kind_defs.Evolved population: A whole-population sample of one MuLTEE line (PA, PM or PO 1–5), taken from the experiment at a given transfer.
kind_defs.Evolved isolate: A single genotype (clone) isolated from one MuLTEE line at a given transfer and regrown, with no further manipulation. Includes isolates of the Small and Large types.
kind_defs.Derived strain: Descends from an ancestor or evolved isolate through a further step outside the main experiment: donut and spread colonies, populations selected against large size on agar, mutation-accumulation lines, and monoculture replays. Also includes pooled isolates and sub-samples such as cluster interiors, cluster exteriors and fragments.
kind_defs.Treatment average: A value reported only as the mean of a treatment’s five lines, so no line is given.
kind_defs.Engineered strain: Built by genetic modification: gene knockouts, overexpression clones, engineered diploid and tetraploid pairs, and fluorescently tagged strains.

measurements.statistic: presence of metabolically driven (buoyancy) flow around/through cluster (MSD exponent alpha ~2)
measurements.conditions: single cluster in non-agitated YEPD (2% glucose), sealed 1.2 mm well or 12-well plate, room temperature
measurements.method: Tracer-bead particle tracking (Mosaic/ImageJ; TrackMate), MSD ~ t^alpha; alpha~2 = advective/ballistic, alpha~1 = diffusive
measurements.notes: Flow enters at the cluster sides and exits from the top; inverting the sample reverses it (buoyancy-driven). Flow speed is roughly constant over ~500 min and comparable to ciliary flows (Fig. 2C; no numeric value in the text).

measurements.statistic: presence of flow (tracer MSD exponent alpha ~1, diffusive)
measurements.conditions: live cluster in PBS without glucose
measurements.method: Tracer-bead particle tracking (Mosaic/ImageJ; TrackMate), MSD ~ t^alpha; alpha~2 = advective/ballistic, alpha~1 = diffusive
measurements.notes: Flows require active fermentation; below a threshold glucose concentration no flows occur (Fig. 3C; value only in figure).

measurements.statistic: presence of flow (tracer MSD exponent alpha ~1, diffusive)
measurements.conditions: dead (metabolically inactive) cluster in glucose-containing medium
measurements.method: Tracer-bead particle tracking (Mosaic/ImageJ; TrackMate), MSD ~ t^alpha; alpha~2 = advective/ballistic, alpha~1 = diffusive
measurements.notes: Killing method given in the supplement.

measurements.statistic: presence of flow around mechanically fragmented sub-threshold pieces

measurements.location: Fig. 3E; fig. S10; Methods (Protocol for breaking clusters)
measurements.notes: Flow depends on cluster size, not genotype.

measurements.statistic: presence of flow around fragments above threshold size
